review.reviewMethod: Independent source review and review addenda across the complete Google delta, followed by Git-pinned source hashing, installed dependency and frozen evidence rehash, every archive-entry comparison, raw log/report inspection and raw visual review. No duplicate full-suite rerun was required for this bounded acceptance.
sourceConclusions: Transport uploads require nonempty acknowledged file IDs; list pagination retains per-file inventory and reports failures. OAuth state/redirect/popup ownership, supported Promise identity API, URL escaping and actual file deletion acknowledgement were reviewed.

Encrypted key JSON remains the recovery payload. Canonical request identities are kept separate from historical compressed-Ethereum JSON headers; selected account and linked child ownership are not inferred from untrusted header labels. Disclosed file labels/addresses remain metadata; secrets remain encrypted.

Export and fresh creation preserve an acknowledged child across primary upload failure, retry the remaining write, and withhold Saved/Finish/selection until actual acknowledgements. Local created IDs are retained across retry. App routing and token clearing keep the owning flow visible and prevent stale export reopening.

Recovery inventories keep primary, child, standalone and orphaned files reachable. Missing-child restore is explicitly primary-only. Actual JSON curve validation permits Ethereum; row completion and failure wording distinguish password validation from storage/selection errors.

limits: Actual production Google sign-in, production OAuth identity/permissions and live Drive read/write/delete remain unqualified. HTTP fixtures establish app behavior under controlled responses, not live service interoperability.
An unknown remote upload outcome may leave orphaned files; no exact-once cloud-write guarantee. All returned files remain reachable in inventory.
Final-source historical Chrome upgrade/private-chain qualification, historical signed Firefox upgrades, Linux CI, final signed distribution, store review and publication remain separate gates.
Native mnemonic/authentication, Android, physical devices, VoiceOver and complete app accessibility remain independent open work. This acceptance is not overall production readiness.
